title: Oog
subtitle: Local DuckLake stack: object storage, catalog, Git and a VS Code workbench with aantje.

tools.name: Workbench
tools.description: VS Code in the browser with Jupyter, DuckDB and DuckLake. Open the medallion notebooks (notebooks/local, notebooks/quack for the Quack server, and notebooks/azure for an Azure DuckLake) in the oog-workspace repository and pick the kernel Oog.

tools.name: aantje
tools.description: VS Code extension for browsing the DuckLake catalog and running SQL. The "Oog Lakehouse" connection is preconfigured (activity bar); the password is the Postgres password from .env and is asked for on the first connect.

tools.name: MCP server
tools.description: Lets Claude Code in the workbench read the DuckLake catalog through aantje; it never writes. Run "aantje: Add MCP Server to Claude Code", then ask Claude Code. A re-created container needs the sign-in to Claude Code and the command again.

tools.name: PostgreSQL
tools.description: Holds the DuckLake catalog. The PostgreSQL extension has the connection "Oog PostgreSQL"; it asks for the password from .env on the first connect. From the host: 127.0.0.1:5433.

tools.name: RustFS console
tools.description: S3 object storage: bucket oog-lake holds the DuckLake data files and the raw test data, oog-iceberg the Iceberg tables of Polaris, oog-gitea the Git objects.

tools.name: Polaris
tools.description: Iceberg REST catalog (Apache Polaris). Use it from aantje: Sync to Iceberg... on a connection writes the lake to the catalog oog_iceberg (sign-in root, secret OOG_POLARIS_CLIENT_SECRET from .env).

tools.name: Gitea
tools.description: Git server with LFS. The oog-workspace repository holds the notebooks; sign in with the Gitea admin account from .env.
